info.name: Google FX Flow Automation API (Production - gen.socialversal.online)
info.description:
Postman Collection for Google FX Flow Video & Image Generation API running on VPS (gen.socialversal.online).

**Base URL:** `https://gen.socialversal.online`

**Settings Notes:**
- `count`: plain number — 1, 2, 3, or 4
- `duration`: plain number in seconds — 4, 6, 8, or 10 (video only)
- `aspectRatio`: "16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:3", "3:4"
- `model`: exact name e.g. "Nano Banana 2 Lite", "Nano Banana 2", "Nano Banana Pro", "Imagen 3", "Omni Flash", "Veo 2"

request.description: Check if Express server, MongoDB connection, and Google FX Flow tool are online.

- `aspectRatio`: "16:9" | "9:16" | "1:1" | "4:3" | "3:4"

variable.description: The itemId returned by the generate endpoint (auto-set by test script)

request.description:
Poll this endpoint after submitting a job.

**Status values:**
- `pending` → job queued
- `processing` → browser automation running
- `completed` → done, `result` has URLs + `downloadUrl` if file saved locally
- `failed` → check `error` field
Returns the 50 most recent generation jobs from MongoDB with their status and results.
Upload a zipped browser-profile.zip file to extract and sync session directly on VPS.
Clear persistent browser profile directory on VPS.
